shared_ledger: apps/backtest-engine/src/martingale/sync_cycle_engine.rs SynchronizedCycleState — ALL families share the same cycle state shape and FO/SO/TP/ABORT machine

machine_definition.FO: completed common boundary AND family residual state valid AND entry threshold crossed => N-leg real first orders (sync_cycle_open event)
machine_definition.SO: aggregate cycle net PnL after all cost < 0 AND family residual moved adversely from last fill AND reserve/liquidation/gross-cap gate allows => every required leg adds real notional, multiplier > 1 (sync_safety_order event)
machine_definition.TP: aggregate net PnL - estimated close cost > TP floor AND residual enters exit region => aggregate close/reduce (sync_tp event)
machine_definition.ABORT: structural break / deadline / legging failure / liquidation buffer breach => aggregate conservative close/reduce; loss enters equity (sync_abort_deadline / sync_force_close_end event)

active_cycle_freeze: group, symbols, weights/beta, direction (from residual sign at open), ladder, fit/state hash all frozen at cycle open; state updates do NOT replace active leg, copy positions, reverse direction, or rewrite SO threshold
cost_contract: entry fee + entry slippage + close/reduce fee + close/reduce slippage + funding at exact settlement boundary + mark-to-market gross/margin + terminal forced close in equity/DD (verified by close_charges_fee_and_slippage + forced_close_cost_is_in_final_equity_curve tests)
conclusion: R3 PASSED. The unified Martingale cycle machine is implemented in the engine and verified by 14 fail-close tests. All families (M1R, M2F, P1, K1, V1) will use this same machine; only the residual computation differs by family.
